reviews.review_description:
I can't stress enough how refreshing it is to play a modern game that takes no time getting into the action. 

With so much seemingly getting in the way of fun with many recent VR and non VR games, I think Airborne Arena gets what's important right: straightforward and fun gameplay that makes wonderful use of virtual reality to get the adrenaline pumping as soon as you jump in.

You don't need me to tell you all of this though: fast paced combat racing in VR is a premise that sells the game on its own!

If you miss the days of blowing stuff up in Twisted Metal like I do, you're gonna love this.

developer_response.body: Thanks for the review! Glad you're enjoying the high-octane action!

reviews.review_title: Super Fun Mix of Racing and Shooting
reviews.review_description:
Airborne Arena is an absolute blast! The races are fast, wild, and super entertaining. Tbh, I thought I might get dizzy since it's a racing game, but nope—zero dizziness. I played some races with friends, and it was really fun.

The tracks are super colorful and full of surprises, with ramps, shortcuts, and other crazy stuff. Every race feels fresh and exciting. If you love racing and shooting, you’ve got to try this game. Highly recommend!
As a fan of fast paced action games, I enjoyed this game very much, the multiplayer is fun and it's great for quick shooting / racing sessions

developer_response.body: Ride on! Thanks for the review.

reviews.review_title: Vertigo and action, the best combination
reviews.review_description: If you like racing/shooting games, you def need to try the demo. Easy to play, difficult to master. The bar is awesome to hang out ant try different weapons. Also I love the cyberpunk style.

developer_response.body: Hey! thanks for the review. We'll see you at the track!

reviews.review_description: Fun arcade action shooter. Great to play with friends.
